summary.intent: Run the GSD plan-phase workflow end-to-end for Phase 68 (cipher-box) — web integration of rotation UX and durable client-side IndexedDB state — producing RESEARCH.md, VALIDATION.md, PATTERNS.md and ultimately PLAN.md files via chained subagent spawns (researcher, pattern-mapper, planner, plan-checker).
summary.outcome: Completed research and pattern-mapping stages: RESEARCH.md and VALIDATION.md committed, PATTERNS.md generated and committed, API surface regenerated; two scope-expanding gaps surfaced (missing apps/api endpoint, missing share-fetch implementation) for the planner to size. Transcript ends just before the planner agent is spawned.

repo: Rotation logic must be wired into packages/sdk/src/client.ts mutation methods (renameItem, moveItem, deleteItem, deleteToBin), not the thin web React hooks, which currently call none of hasCoveringGrant/rotateReadFromNode.

executeLazyRotation has zero callers in the live tree (deletion path is nearly free to rotate); addShareKeys/reWrapForRecipients DO have callers (useAuth.ts, useSharedNavigation.ts) needing rerouting.

share.service.ts's fetchReceivedShares/fetchSentShares are stub functions that unconditionally throw — D-07's rootGeneration seeding has no real data path yet, despite the generated API client already exposing the needed fields.

reMintGrantsRootedAt's updateGrantFn (D-10/D-11 owner reconcile) has no backing API endpoint — shares.controller.ts lacks a PATCH route for readDescriptorRef/rootGeneration, meaning Phase 68 needs an apps/api addition plus `pnpm api:generate`, expanding scope beyond apps/web.
No `idb` npm package anywhere in the repo — new IndexedDB stores must follow the hand-rolled raw-indexedDB Promise-wrapping pattern used in identity.ts and search-index.service.ts.
apps/web/vitest.config.ts only includes src/**/*.test.ts with environment: 'node' — no IndexedDB test shim exists, a Wave 0 gap before rotation-state.test.ts can be written.
ScopeExitDeps.rotate injection seam lives in packages/sdk-core/src/rotation/scope.ts; the existing anti-clobber sequenceNumber guard at client.ts:369-381 needs inverted polarity for D-04.
New apps/api PATCH route for grant reconcile should mirror updateShareItemName/UpdateItemNameDto exactly (ownership check via sharerId, class-validator decorators, HttpCode(204)).

Notification/badge UI work extends the existing notification.store.ts Zustand store and NotificationToast.tsx early-return idioms; project convention requires string-literal unions only (per scope.ts docblock).
navigator.locks (D-09) is a first-time use in this codebase with no existing analog to follow.

workflow: GSD plan-phase pipeline order: research decision (AskUserQuestion) → spawn researcher → VALIDATION.md creation (if RESEARCH.md has a Validation Architecture section) → non-blocking drift check → intel API-surface regen → spawn pattern-mapper → spawn planner → verify loop.

Subagent spawns produce no visible output until they finish (~1-5 min) — this is expected behavior, not a freeze, and the orchestrator should wait for the automatic task-notification rather than polling.
VALIDATION.md and PATTERNS.md are not auto-committed by their generating steps and require an explicit manual commit afterward.

friction: A `commit_failed` status reported for VALIDATION.md was a false negative — required an extra verification step (git log/status) to confirm the commit (8a5d93769) actually landed.
